def count_insertions(s, index):
    if index >= len(s):
        return 0
    end = index
    while end < len(s) and s[end] == s[index]:
        end += 1
    run_length = end - index
    count = 1 if run_length % 2 == 0 else 0
    return count + count_insertions(s, end)

def main():
    s = input().strip()
    result = count_insertions(s, 0)
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
